maven.description: A tool to manipulate PROV representations from the command line.

license.verification: SHA-256 computed from the exact base64 bytes returned for license.txt at tagged commit aef0816c2a277958774fac88cf0076248e7065cc; decoded bytes reproduce Git blob 081be2ec53583c2ac533e041abd9f34add7a1b2e.

swos_oracle_contract.artifact_uri_rule: relative path under the oracle-manifest directory
swos_oracle_contract.artifact_sha256_rule: lowercase SHA-256 of the exact executable package bytes

package_strategy.required: one independently reviewable offline oracle execution package whose exact identity includes ProvToolbox 2.2.3 and every runtime dependency needed by the SWOS adapter
package_strategy.preferred_shape: a deterministic archive containing the provconvert launcher/runtime, fully materialized dependency closure, dependency inventory with per-file SHA-256, upstream MIT license, third-party licence inventory, Java/runtime requirement record, and the thin SWOS-output adapter; hash the archive itself and verify every internal digest before execution
must_include: complete transitive dependency inventory with versions and hashes
third-party licence inventory generated/retained by the upstream packaging route
thin adapter that emits the SWOS oracle-output JSON contract without deciding SWOS scholarly policy
prohibited: hashing only provconvert-2.2.3.jar while leaving its dependency closure unbound
hashing only a wrapper while leaving the actual ProvToolbox/dependency identity unbound
using SWOS's own PROV parser as the independent oracle

preflight: Acquire Maven artifact org.openprovenance.prov:provconvert:2.2.3 and resolve its exact transitive dependency closure in a clean external build environment.
Materialize that closure into one deterministic offline package; record Maven repository/source URIs and SHA-256 for every file.
Verify exact license.txt SHA-256 and retain upstream/third-party notices.
Record Java/runtime identity and execute provconvert --version or equivalent, binding the returned identity to 2.2.3.
Test the adapter against one valid and one invalid permitted fixture without using SWOS's own parser as truth.
Obtain the required maintainer/steward approval bound to package digest, command, Java identity and corpus manifest.
Only then promote benchmark/provenance/oracle-manifest.json from not_run to an accepted status and execute the exact-head certification workflow.
known_contract_risk: Main verifies one local artifact file before executing the oracle command. Therefore the final `artifact` must itself be the cryptographic root for the entire executable dependency closure, not a launcher that discovers unbound jars from the host.
